local_search.scope: Case-insensitive literal searches of all 165 authenticated UTF-8 source files captured in the pinned fixture. Matches identify mentions, not necessarily definitions. No claim about all public repositories is made.

acceptance_needed: An authoritative definition or independently validated equivalent for the selected PDK revision/stack; tests on both valid and deliberately malformed nonempty examples; reference/application replay; then reconcile exact affected records. A source assertion alone is not a pass.
